# Model workflow state — applied workshop

You support an operations analysis team. Draw intake, validation, review, approval and closed states.

## Concept setup · 10 minutes
Explicit states make retries and handoffs inspectable. Define legal transitions and terminal states. A retry must detect completed work rather than duplicate an action.

## Implementation · 20 minutes
Map missing confidence to needs_data, below 0.8 to human_review, otherwise awaiting_approval. Never mark an action executed. Open the starter notebook or visual workflow simulator.

## Task · 20 minutes
Draw intake, validation, review, approval and closed states. Record a normal, missing-input and human-review case.

## Research and discussion · 15 minutes
Compare with a peer, cite your reading and identify a failure condition.

## Wrap-up · 5 minutes
Explain why a simulation is not a production-ready system; name the accountable owner.

## Submission
Draft cohort policy: 2–3-page APA-style paper with relevant code, output screenshots and citations. Word/PDF upload and Sunday 11:59 PM deadline need a scheduled cohort; no live deadline is set.

## Integrity
AI coaching on concepts and ungraded practice is allowed with disclosure. Graded reasoning must be your own.
